user: Can you explain how PrEP works and its effectiveness in preventing HIV?
bot:
PrEP works by blocking HIV from entering your body. It helps keep your immune system safe.

There are two main types of PrEP:

- **Oral PrEP (Truvada):** A daily pill taken to prevent HIV.
- **Injectable PrEP (Apretude and Yeztugo):** Given as an injection every 2 or 6 months.

Both oral and injectable PrEP are up to 99% effective in preventing HIV infection when taken as directed. This means they work really well if you follow the schedule.

Talk to your healthcare provider to see which option is best for you!
